startRule: UIUX-CONVERGE-0 may start because DECIDE-0 is merged, the repository-bounded prototype baseline exists, and CAPABILITY-CLOSURE-E2 has reconciled the current canonical 13-surface inventory. PR-09/C5 remains a completion gate, not a start gate.
completionNonClaim: Completion of UIUX-CONVERGE-0 still cannot claim representative usability or assistive-technology effectiveness; E3-HUMAN remains external. CAPABILITY-CLOSURE-E2 must be rerun before done and does not close E3-GOV or E4-DEPLOY.
bridgeDecision: Do not add PREP-0. CAPABILITY-CLOSURE-E2 is an entry/regression gate inside UIUX-CONVERGE-0, not a new serial slice; keep C5 terminal-before-done and keep E3/E4 external.
claimBoundary: Repository prototype operability plus E2 functional closure for the current canonical 13-surface inventory. It is not representative human usability, production readiness, protected-branch enforcement, legal compliance, certification, market fit or enterprise readiness.
